findings.title: Missing concrete strength class and exposure class
findings.message: The description requires concrete to be ‘C 12/15’ for the Sauberkeitsschicht and ‘C 20/25’ for the SOHLENBETON, but the position does not specify the required exposure class (e.g., XC4, XF1) or the exact dimensions of the concrete elements. According to VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 and STLB‑Bau § 3.1, the specification must be unequivocal and exhaustive, including material class, exposure class, and dimensions.
findings.suggestion: Add explicit exposure class (e.g., XC4) and confirm dimensions for all concrete elements. Specify that the concrete shall be of the indicated class and exposure, and that the contractor must provide a proof of compliance.

findings.title: Ambiguous wording regarding ‘nach Wahl des AN’
findings.message: The text states that ‘Bei Neuerstellung von Wänden wird für alle Aussparungen keine gesonderte Vergütung gewährt.’ This implies that the contractor may choose the concrete type for wall openings, which is ambiguous and shifts quality decisions to the contractor. VOB/A § 7 Abs. 1 requires the specification to be clear and exhaustive; ambiguous wording may lead to disputes.
findings.suggestion: Replace ‘nach Wahl des AN’ with a specific concrete type and class, e.g., ‘Beton C 20/25 nach DIN 1045, XC4’ for all wall openings. Clarify that no separate remuneration is granted for these openings.

findings.title: Risk transfer for delivery of all fastening material
findings.message: The clause ‘Sämtliches Klein- und Befestigungsmaterial … ist durch den AN zu liefern und einzubauen. Die Kosten hierfür sind einzurechnen.’ transfers the risk of material supply and cost to the contractor without specifying the exact materials or quantities. According to VOB/B § 2 Abs. 6, such risk transfer must be clearly defined and justified; otherwise it may be considered a unilateral clause and potentially invalid under § 307 BGB.
findings.suggestion: Specify the exact fastening materials, sizes, and quantities required, and include a separate line item for their cost. Ensure that the contractor’s risk is limited to the delivery of specified items, not all fastening material generically.

findings.title: Unit mismatch for Sauberkeitsschicht thickness
findings.message: The description specifies a 10 cm thick Sauberkeitsschicht, but the unit in the LV is 20 m², which does not directly reflect the thickness. This may lead to calculation errors if the contractor interprets the unit as area only.
findings.suggestion: Add a separate line item for the Sauberkeitsschicht with unit ‘m³’ or clarify that the 20 m² refers to the area of the layer, not the volume.
